sloka: कच्चिदर्थं च धर्मं च कामं च जयतां वर ।विभज्य काले कालज्ञ सर्वान् वरद सेवसे ॥ २.१००.६४॥
transliteration: kaccidarthaṁ ca dharmaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca jayatāṁ vara ।vibhajya kāle kālajña sarvān varada sevase ॥ 2.100.64॥

translations.english: O highly sagacious Bharata, those brahmins who can comprehend the meaning of all scriptures along with the inhabitants of the city and country, I trust, are seeking your happiness.
